title: Two gametes meet
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Fertilization combines sperm and egg to form a zygote. The figure represents the fusion step, not the many later divisions of the developing organism.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: When a sperm cell fuses with an egg cell in fertilization, what single cell results? Fertilization combines sperm and egg to form a zygote. The figure represents the fusion step, not the many later divisions of the developing organism.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
